candidate.text: Operating Cilium in `--datapath-mode=lb-only` for plain Docker mode now requires to add an additional `--enable-k8s=false` to the command line, otherwise it is assumed that Kubernetes is present.

evidence.excerpt:
* Operating Cilium in `--datapath-mode=lb-only` for plain Docker mode now requires to
  add an additional `--enable-k8s=false` to the command line, otherwise it is assumed
  that Kubernetes is present.
